decisive_spans.text: Orcein stain demonstrated reduction of elastic fibers in the dermis beneath the epidermal dell

response.rationale: The vignette explicitly states that "Orcein stain demonstrated reduction of elastic fibers in the dermis beneath the epidermal dell", which is the exact support item for Atrophic dermatofibrosis (D2). While Mid-dermal elastolysis (D1) also mentions reduction of elastic fibers, it does not specify the location as precisely as D2, making D2 a stronger match.
